en: Oh, good, you're up! Listen, have you heard of Professor Juniper? She studies Pokémon. She's quite famous.
We were friends years ago, and she called me this morning, out of the blue!
So, {player}... how would you like a Pokémon of your very own?
Really? You don't mean that! Every child in Aspertia dreams of having a partner.
I knew it! That's the first part sorted, then.
Next question. Do you know what a Pokédex is?
It's a little machine that notes down every kind of Pokémon you come across, all by itself.
Of course you do. It writes down every Pokémon you meet, all on its own. Clever thing.
And you'd like one of those too, wouldn't you?
Think about it! Filling one up means going out and seeing the world. Doesn't that sound wonderful?
Then that's settled. The professor has sent her assistant all the way up here to meet you.
Her name is Bianca. I'm told you can't miss her: just look for a big green hat.
She'll have a Pokédex for you, and a Pokémon to be your partner. Go and find her!
You look worn out, dear. Sit down for a minute and let your Pokémon rest.
There, all better. Off you go, and be careful out there!
Bianca's somewhere in town. Try the high places: visitors always want to see the view.
Good morning, sleepyhead. Come here a moment, I've got something to ask you.
